scenicChapters.title: Historical Complex of Split with the Palac → Velika and Mala Crljivica
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 53 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-historical-complex-of-split-with-.story: 318 km from Split to Split, about 5 h 29 of riding. On the way it passes Velika and Mala Crljivica, Ravanjska vrata, Dugo polje at Blidinje and back through Ravanjska vrata. The highest point is about 1,250 m. It crosses from Croatia into Bosnia & Herzegovina - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
